                        House Journal
                               FRIDAY, OCTOBER 2, 2026

                                                    

Produced daily by the State of Iowa during the sessions of the General Assembly.
(The official bound copy will be available after a reasonable time upon adjournment.)

1st Day                     FRIDAY, OCTOBER 2, 2026                             1187

                JOURNAL OF THE HOUSE
                       First Calendar Day - First Session Day

                                                Hall of the House of Representatives
                                           Des Moines, Iowa, Friday, October 2, 2026

   Pursuant to the proclamation of the Governor, the Honorable
Kimberly Reynolds convened the Ninety-first General Assembly in an
Extraordinary Session. The House was called to order at 10:52 a.m. by
the Honorable Pat Grassley, Speaker of the House.

[...]

                      FINAL ADJOURNMENT

    By virtue of Senate Concurrent Resolution 104, duly adopted, the day
of Friday, October 2, 2026, having arrived, the Speaker of the House of
Representatives declared the 2026 Extraordinary Session of the Ninety-
first General Assembly adjourned sine die at 6:53 p.m.
